Definition: to make a loud sound (like English 'hum'); by implication, to be in great commotion or tumult, to rage, war, moan, clamor
BiblicalUsage: 1) to murmur, growl, roar, cry aloud, mourn, rage, sound, make noise, tumult, be clamorous, be disquieted, be loud, be moved, be troubled, be in an uproar; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to growl; 1a2) to murmur (fig. of a soul in prayer); 1a3) to roar; 1a4) to be in a stir, be in a commotion; 1a5) to be boisterous, be turbulent
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
